external_collaboration.evidence_quote: TEP works with partners to transform trimmings generated through our vegetation management program into high-quality compost used to grow new trees through an innovative green waste recycling partnership with Civano Plant Farm and Nursery.
TEP's certified arborists work with Asplundh Tree Expert Company year-round to identify trees and other vegetation that are in danger of interfering with overhead equipment.
